title: Go: Event Bus
description: Implement a publish-subscribe event bus in Go using channels and goroutines for decoupled communication.

steps.title: Basic event bus with Subscribe and Publish
steps.description: Create an `EventBus` struct with `Subscribe(topic string, ch chan interface{})` and `Publish(topic string, data interface{})`. Use a `map[string][]chan interface{}` for subscribers. Publish a message and print subscriber receipt using `fmt.Printf("Received on %s: %v\n", topic, data)`.
hints: Publish sends to all subscribed channels
Blocking send means slow subscribers block the publisher

verification.failureMessage: Print the topic and data received by each subscriber.

steps.title: Non-blocking publish with buffered channels
steps.description: Modify `Publish` to use `select { case ch <- data: default: }` for non-blocking sends. Use buffered channels (`make(chan interface{}, 10)`). Drop messages if a subscriber's buffer is full. Print dropped messages using `fmt.Printf("Dropped: %s -> %s\n", topic, data)`.
hints: Select with default makes send non-blocking
Dropped messages is a form of backpressure

verification.failureMessage: Print dropped messages when subscriber buffer is full.

steps.title: Wildcard topic matching
steps.description: Add wildcard subscription support: subscribe to `users.*` to receive `users.created`, `users.updated`, etc. Implement `Subscribe(pattern string, ch chan)` that uses `strings.HasPrefix` or `path.Match` matching. Print matched events using `fmt.Printf("Matched: %s via %s\n", topic, pattern)`.
hints: Use strings.HasPrefix or path.Match for pattern matching

verification.failureMessage: Print each matched event with its topic and pattern.

steps.title: Async event processing with worker pool
steps.description: Create a worker pool that processes events from the bus asynchronously. Use a fixed number of goroutines that read from a shared channel. Handle event processing with error recovery (recover from panics). Print processing logs using `fmt.Printf("Worker %d: processed %s\n", id, topic)`.
hints: Worker pool pattern: N goroutines, 1 channel
Use recover() in each worker to handle panics

verification.successMessage: Async event processing with workers works!
verification.failureMessage: Print each worker ID and the event it processed.
